svg.aria-label: Lifecycle of missions, runs, attempts and gates: every non-terminal state has a timeout, losses retry on the same lane, humans decide gates, and a mission only ends when GitHub reports enough merged PRs or a human stops it.

text.font-family: Newsreader, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Lifecycle — how work moves, and why it never stops silently

text.font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four state machines in the Postgres brain. Every non-terminal state has a maximum age; a lost worker retries on the same lane; humans decide gates; “landed” comes only from GitHub.
